items.reason: A 2% salicylic acid cleanser to help keep pores looking clearer and the few spots less noticeable on oily-looking skin.
A light, mattifying gel moisturizer that adds comfort and helps reduce shine without feeling heavy.
A mineral SPF 50 to use every morning, since exfoliating cleansers can leave skin more sun-sensitive.

response.routine_note: Use the cleanser once a day at first (evening is easiest), then add the gel moisturizer, and apply the SPF every morning as the last step. If skin feels dry or stinging, cut back the cleanser to every other day, and if the spots look more widespread or stubborn after a couple of months, a dermatologist can give better guidance.
